intro.definition: An AI technique that enhances Large Language Models by retrieving relevant information from external knowledge bases before generating responses.
intro.paperTitle: Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Knowledge-Intensive NLP Tasks
intro.explanation: Unlike traditional LLMs that rely only on training data, RAG fetches relevant documents at query time — enabling accurate, up-to-date, and verifiable responses.

education.ragExplanation: RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) is like giving an AI a textbook before an exam. Instead of guessing from memory, the AI can look up the answer in YOUR documents. This makes responses accurate, verifiable, and grounded in facts.
education.step1: 1. UPLOAD: Your document becomes the AI's reference material
education.step2: 2. CHUNK: Split into searchable pieces (too big = slow, too small = loses context)
education.step3: 3. EMBED: Convert to meaning-vectors (similar meanings = similar numbers)
education.step4: 4. RETRIEVE: Find the chunks closest to your question
education.step5: 5. GENERATE: AI answers using ONLY the relevant context
